description: Versioned prompt catalog for Carrel product, engineering, and quality audits. Prompts are advisory and run local-first unless explicit credentials/config are added.

prompts.intent: Audit a Carrel surface against DESIGN.md and the premium UI roadmap, then produce a prioritized implementation punch list.

inputs.description: Dashboard, Library, Reader, Ask, Study, Session, or Onboarding.
App route or navigation destination under review.

outputs: Concrete code-change checklist with file ownership.
Visual verification plan for desktop and narrow widths.
success_criteria: Recommendations preserve the Carrel design language.
No decorative surfaces or animation choices conflict with DESIGN.md.
Every finding maps to a route, component, and verification step.
risks: Over-styling operational screens.
Adding animation or layout churn that hurts reading and review speed.
Duplicating already-shipped components.
model_notes: Prefer existing tokens, components, and icons before proposing new primitives.
Flag any suggestion that requires new runtime dependencies.
prompts.template: You are auditing {surface} at {route}. Review {target_files} against {constraints}. Return findings, a scoped implementation checklist, and verification steps. Optimize for a premium Carrel experience without decorative noise.

prompts.intent: Map a learner workflow from intent to completion, identify friction, and define fixes that fit the local-first Carrel product model.
outputs: Top friction points with user impact.
Implementation plan with copy, states, and telemetry events.
success_criteria: The flow reduces decision cost for first-run and returning learners.
Every proposed state has a clear empty, loading, success, and error shape.
Telemetry uses only local, PII-free event metadata.
risks: Adding educational copy that explains UI mechanics in-app.
Treating demo data as if it were user data.
Logging search terms, filenames, or document text.
model_notes: Ground recommendations in the user's immediate learning goal.
Prefer smaller workflow changes that can be verified with Playwright.
prompts.template: Trace the {persona} workflow through {surface} starting at {route}. Within {constraints}, identify friction, missing states, and local-only telemetry. Return a journey map, fixes, and acceptance checks.

prompts.intent: Review Reader, Library, and study surfaces for render, scroll, animation, and bundle regressions.

inputs.description: Components, hooks, and CSS modules under review.
Screenshots, traces, test output, or measurements.

outputs: Measurement plan before and after implementation.
success_criteria: Scroll and page navigation remain stable at large document sizes.
Animations use transform and opacity only.
Bundle impact is measured or explicitly bounded.
risks: Adding heavy libraries for narrow UI behavior.
Re-rendering large PDF/page lists on unrelated state changes.
Breaking keyboard-driven reader workflows.
model_notes: Treat smooth reading as the primary performance metric.
Prefer virtualized, memoized, and signal-local changes.
prompts.template: Profile {surface} using {target_files} and {evidence}. Under {constraints}, identify render, scroll, animation, and bundle risks. Return fixes and before/after measurements.

prompts.intent: Audit FastAPI routes for consistency, validation, local safety, and additive compatibility.

inputs.description: API route family or endpoint list.
Current tests, logs, or reported failures.

success_criteria: Existing frontend calls remain compatible.
Upload and heavy-operation inputs are bounded.
Errors are useful without exposing secrets or document content.
risks: Breaking established response shapes.
Leaking local paths, API keys, filenames, or document text.
Adding external queues before exhausting local jobs infrastructure.
model_notes: Use additive models and routes when possible.
Check frontend endpoint wrappers before changing route responses.
prompts.template: Audit {route} in {target_files} using {evidence}. Preserve {constraints}. Return compatibility risks, validation fixes, and tests for the backend/API layer.

prompts.intent: Review SQLite migrations, indexes, backups, and local vector fallback behavior for durability and speed.

inputs.description: SQLite, local-only, and migration safety constraints.
EXPLAIN output, test failures, logs, or runtime symptoms.

outputs: Index proposals tied to concrete queries.
Backup, WAL, and fallback verification plan.
success_criteria: Migrations are idempotent and covered by tests.
Indexes target due cards, search, concepts, jobs, or usage events.
sqlite-vec unavailability remains clear and non-fatal.
risks: Adding indexes without query justification.
Using unsafe SQL string interpolation.
Making vector support mandatory on machines where it is unavailable.
model_notes: Keep migration files append-only.
Prefer parameterization tests for risky query builders.
prompts.template: Review database files {target_files} with evidence {evidence}. Under {constraints}, propose safe migrations, indexes, backup/WAL checks, and sqlite-vec fallback verification.

prompts.intent: Audit key Carrel views for keyboard, screen-reader labels, focus order, and contrast-sensitive UI.

inputs.description: Route to load in smoke checks.
Components and CSS modules under review.

success_criteria: Primary actions have accessible names.
Focus never disappears during panel toggles or mode changes.
Color-dependent indicators also have semantic labels or text.
risks: Icon-only buttons without aria-label.
Focus traps in search, tour, modal, or reader focus mode.
Contrast regressions in glass surfaces.
model_notes: Prioritize actual learner workflows over broad theoretical coverage.
Write checks that can run in CI without external services.
prompts.template: Audit accessibility for {surface} at {route}. Review {target_files} under {constraints}. Return keyboard, focus, ARIA, contrast findings and a Playwright plus axe test plan.

prompts.intent: Define local-only usage events and privacy-safe payloads for Carrel flows.
outputs: Tests proving PII is not persisted.
success_criteria: No document text, filenames, questions, answers, API keys, or identifiers leave local storage.
Event helper has one stable client API.
Backend storage is additive and queryable for local debugging.
risks: Logging raw queries or selected text.
Treating local metrics as external analytics.
Creating event names that drift across surfaces.
model_notes: Use event names from the roadmap unless there is a compatibility reason.
Prefer booleans, counts, enum states, and durations.
prompts.template: For {surface}, define local-only events from {metric_names}. Instrument {target_files} within {constraints}. Return payload allowlists, call sites, and privacy tests.

prompts.intent: Extend CI with deterministic validation, smoke checks, and advisory gates without paid services.

inputs.description: Current check output or flake notes.

outputs: Exact commands to run locally and in CI.
success_criteria: Prompt validation is blocking and deterministic.
Visual/accessibility checks are lightweight and scoped to key views.
AI prompt execution remains advisory unless credentials are explicitly configured.
risks: Creating slow CI that discourages frequent PRs.
Failing CI on unavailable external credentials.
Hiding real regressions behind continue-on-error.
model_notes: Keep local verification commands copy-pasteable.
Separate required quality gates from exploratory audits.
prompts.template: Review CI files {target_files} with evidence {evidence}. Under {constraints}, propose blocking and advisory gates, exact commands, artifacts, and flake handling.

prompts.intent: Review a Carrel diff with findings first, ordered by severity, emphasizing bugs, regressions, and missing tests.

inputs.description: Test output, screenshots, or runtime notes.

outputs: Findings first, with file and line references.
success_criteria: Every issue describes a user-visible or maintenance risk.
Line references are tight and actionable.
No style-only noise unless it blocks the roadmap.
risks: Summarizing before findings.
Flagging speculative issues without evidence.
Missing tests for new public interfaces.
model_notes: Use a code-review stance, not a feature-brainstorm stance.
Call out residual risk when no findings remain.
prompts.template: Review {target_files} under {constraints}, using evidence {evidence}. Return findings first, then questions, then a concise verification summary.

prompts.intent: Turn a roadmap slice into focused frontend, backend, type, visual, accessibility, and runtime tests.

inputs.description: Known failing tests or coverage gaps.

success_criteria: Tests scale with risk and public API surface.
Commands are runnable without external services.
Known unrelated failures are documented instead of hidden.
risks: Only testing happy paths.
Adding brittle visual assertions before UI is stable.
Letting generated API type drift go unnoticed.
model_notes: Prefer narrow suites during development and broader gates before PR handoff.
Include migration tests when schema changes.
prompts.template: For {surface}, build a test plan for {target_files}. Account for {constraints} and evidence {evidence}. Return commands, coverage, and residual risks.

prompts.intent: Evaluate whether a learner can quickly import, read, ask, review, and return to the right place in Carrel.

inputs.description: The end-to-end loop or surface being analyzed.

outputs: Task script for a manual or Playwright run.
success_criteria: The learner can resume reading exactly where they left off.
Reader panels, focus mode, and search are discoverable without clutter.
Ask and Study surfaces preserve evidence and momentum.
risks: Optimizing isolated screens instead of the learning loop.
Losing page or panel state across navigation.
Adding copy that explains the product instead of helping the task.
model_notes: Use the task script to generate product fixes, not just notes.
Preserve local-first privacy expectations throughout the flow.
prompts.template: Analyze the {persona} usability loop for {surface}, starting at {route}. Respect {constraints}. Return a task script, observed gaps, prioritized fixes, and validation checks.
